Generate random Lotka-Volterra adjacency matrix with a given proportion of interactions (approximately)

Source: R/RcppExports.R
generateRandomGLVadjMat.Rd

Generate random Lotka-Volterra adjacency matrix with a given proportion of interactions (approximately)

Usage

generateRandomGLVadjMat(numSp, C, propInt)

Arguments

numSp

Integer, number of species

C

Double, Probability of interaction = Connectivity = number of interacions/(numSp^2)

propInt

Numeric vector, Proportion of interactions, there are 5 types of interactions the elements of the vector represent 1= mutualism (+,+), 2=Predator-prey (+,-), 3= competition (-,-), 4=Comensalims (+,0), 5=Amensalism (-,0).

Value

A NumericMatrix with the GLV type of adjacency matrix
